summary: Local Ollama development profiles with isolated OpenCode and bounded inference

delivery.outcome: Isolated local development profiles select one declared model and consistently bind caller routing, execution budgets and the independently validated child worker policy.
nonGoals: Fleet ticket ownership, shared routing changes and protected publication policy remain controller responsibilities.

architecture.decision: Render opt-in TOML/JSON profiles, pass caller policy locator to the existing worker and pin worker source before inherited PYTHONPATH. Preserve process policy fallback for credential-only callers and real descendant cleanup.
architecture.rollback: Select the previous caller runtime/profile; keep shared gateway and fleet services intact.

commands: Protected local OneDev and independent Validator exact-head publication
validation.evidence: Offline profile/routing/worker regression checks plus external minis SDK and tool-use pilot receipts.
